"""validate_rows spine: keep rows with a close, sorted by (date, ticker)."""

from mdata import RawRow
from mdata.validate import validate_rows


def test_sample_drops_the_blank_close(contract_sample):
    rows = [RawRow(**row) for row in contract_sample("mdata.RawRow")["rows"]]

    out = validate_rows(rows)

    assert len(out) == 7
    assert RawRow("2024-01-04", "AAA", None) not in out
    assert RawRow("2024-01-04", "BBB", 51.0) in out


def test_rows_come_back_sorted_by_date_then_ticker():
    rows = [
        RawRow("2024-01-03", "BBB", 2.0),
        RawRow("2024-01-02", "BBB", 1.0),
        RawRow("2024-01-03", "AAA", 3.0),
        RawRow("2024-01-02", "AAA", 4.0),
    ]

    out = validate_rows(rows)

    assert [(row.date, row.ticker) for row in out] == [
        ("2024-01-02", "AAA"),
        ("2024-01-02", "BBB"),
        ("2024-01-03", "AAA"),
        ("2024-01-03", "BBB"),
    ]


def test_all_blank_closes_give_no_rows():
    assert validate_rows([RawRow("2024-01-02", "AAA", None)]) == []
